title: obsidian-processor plan
description: What Claude decided for each note. vault.py apply executes it: backup, splits, edits, frontmatter, renames/moves, link fixes, log. Paths are relative to the vault root.

request.description: The user's request, for the manifest (e.g. "triage my vault").

path.description: Current path (or unique name) of the note.

title.description: New title = new filename without .md. Omit to keep the current name.

folder.description: Destination folder, e.g. "20-Areas" or "30-Reference/RAG Pipeline". "" = vault root. Omit to keep.

title.description: mode=new: title of the new note.

folder.description: mode=new: folder of the new note (default: the parent's final folder).

target.description: mode=append: existing note to append to (path or name).

summary.description: Log line for the created note.

insert_top.description: Text inserted right under the frontmatter (edit requests only).

body_edits.description: Exact replacements (edit requests only). Each find must occur exactly once in the body.

summary.description: One human sentence for the log and the report.

questions.description: Things Claude would not guess. Each becomes a checkbox under 'Needs you' in the Processing Log.

frontmatter.description: Proposed properties. Existing user values win (see references/frontmatter.md). Don't send created/modified/processed/aliases/split_from; the script sets them.

related.description: Note names; written as [[links]] with final names.
